title: Reference-State Bootstrap Correction and Kernel Characterization of Residual-Based Fit Indices in Structural Equation Models
summary: Sampling error affects the finite-sample values of residual-based fit indices. We show that the unweighted comparative fit index ($CFI_u$) rests on a quadratic-kernel maximum mean discrepancy and that a Gaussian-kernel comparative fit index (KCFI) converges to $CFI_u$ as bandwidth increases. Because kernel discrepancies lack an analytic sampling correction, we extend expected-discrepancy bootstrap methods to a fitted-correlation reference state: the sample is transformed to reproduce the fitted correlation matrix, then resampled and refitted to estimate the exact-fit sampling component.…
